summary.title: Making sure you're not a bot! (Anubis challenge page for inria.hal.science)
summary.one_liner: This URL is an Anubis bot-protection challenge page, not the paper; the intended content is "Correct and Efficient Work-Stealing for Weak Memory Models," which you would need to open directly in a browser.
takeaways: The page itself contains no paper content; it is an Anubis proof-of-work challenge gate.
The listed paper gives the work-stealing deque a proven atomics form.
The paper derives which fences push, take and steal need on Arm and x86.
Anubis requires modern JavaScript, so plugins such as JShelter may need to be disabled for this domain to view the content.
summary.summary: The fetched page is a bot-protection interstitial from Anubis, which runs a Hashcash-style proof-of-work check before serving the site. It contains no text from the listed paper, so the summary relies on the listing note: the paper "Correct and Efficient Work-Stealing for Weak Memory Models" gives the work-stealing deque a proven atomics form and derives the fences that push, take and steal require on Arm and x86. The page also notes that Anubis needs modern JavaScript and that plugins like JShelter can block it. To read the paper, open the URL in a browser with those plugins disabled and wait for the challenge to pass.
